Summary: Trends.Earth is a free, open-source tool designed to monitor and analyze land changes, particularly focusing on land degradation and restoration efforts. Developed through a collaboration between Conservation International, Lund University, and NASA, with support from the Global Environment Facility (GEF), it enables users to utilize globally available data alongside customized local maps to assess land condition changes over time.
Top functionalities:
Land Degradation Assessment: Evaluates land degradation by analyzing productivity, land cover, and soil organic carbon, supporting Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) Indicator 15.3.1.
Restoration Monitoring: Assists in planning and monitoring restoration efforts by providing tools to track improvements in land condition.
Urbanization Tracking: Monitors urban expansion and its impacts on land resources, aiding in sustainable urban planning.
Customizable Analysis: Allows integration of local datasets for tailored analyses, enhancing the relevance and accuracy of assessments.
Reporting Support: Facilitates the development of official national reports for submission to the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD).

Summary: InVEST (Integrated Valuation of Ecosystem Services and Tradeoffs) is a free, open-source suite of software models developed by the Natural Capital Project. It is designed to map and value the goods and services provided by nature, enabling decision-makers to assess the trade-offs associated with alternative management choices and to identify areas where investment in natural capital can enhance human development and conservation.
Top functionalities:
Ecosystem Service Modeling: Provides models for terrestrial, freshwater, marine, and coastal ecosystems to evaluate services such as carbon storage, water purification, and crop pollination. 
Scenario Analysis: Allows users to simulate and compare the impacts of different land-use or policy scenarios on ecosystem services.
Spatially Explicit Outputs: Generates maps and reports that illustrate the distribution and economic value of ecosystem services across a landscape.
User-Friendly Interface: Features a modular design that is accessible to a wide range of users, including governments, NGOs, and private sector entities.
Integration with GIS: Compatible with Geographic Information System (GIS) data, facilitating the incorporation of spatial data into analyses.
Services: Sustainability Technology, Sustainable Project Management, Technology Integration

Summary: InVEST (Integrated Valuation of Ecosystem Services and Tradeoffs) is a free, open-source suite of software models developed by the Natural Capital Project. It is designed to map and value the goods and services provided by nature, enabling decision-makers to assess the trade-offs associated with alternative management choices and to identify areas where investment in natural capital can enhance human development and conservation.
Top functionalities:
Ecosystem Service Modeling: Provides models for terrestrial, freshwater, marine, and coastal ecosystems to evaluate services such as carbon storage, water purification, and crop pollination. 
Scenario Analysis: Allows users to simulate and compare the impacts of different land-use or policy scenarios on ecosystem services.
Spatially Explicit Outputs: Generates maps and reports that illustrate the distribution and economic value of ecosystem services across a landscape.
User-Friendly Interface: Features a modular design that is accessible to a wide range of users, including governments, NGOs, and private sector entities.
Integration with GIS: Compatible with Geographic Information System (GIS) data, facilitating the incorporation of spatial data into analyses.
Services: Sustainability Technology, Sustainable Project Management, Technology Integration

We’re on a mission to inspire and empower businesses to accelerate global action on climate. Our passionate community of over 20,000 businesses and 40,000 members has so far funded over 77 million trees and avoided over 3 million tCO2e in just three years of impact.

We can give your business the right tools, information, and advice for each stage of the journey to net-zero. From calculating your carbon footprint, to reducing your emissions, to funding high-quality climate action, to sharing your impact.

Start making a difference today. For your business. For our planet.

We combine the expertise of climate scientists with the knowledge of experienced businesspeople to provide a trusted route to net zero for your business. Our tools help your business access all the benefits of getting on the road to net zero, from competitive advantage to customer preference, employee engagement, recruitment and investor demand.

We have worked with big brands and industry bodies to create a range of sector-specific industry-standard methodologies for reaching Net Zero. Summary: BirdNET is a research platform developed by the Cornell Lab of Ornithology and Chemnitz University of Technology, designed to identify birds by sound using machine learning. It supports various devices and serves as a citizen science platform and analysis tool for large audio datasets, currently recognizing around 3,000 bird species globally.

Summary: DeepForestry tackles the daunting task of highly accurate biomass measurements for entire forests. In a traditional setting a sample of trees would be measured and then generalized to the population. "Our drone flies into the forest and can accurately measure 1000 trees every 20 minutes. All you need to do is place the drone on the ground in your forest and push one button. Then the drone will take off and conduct a scan of the surrounding forest and terrain, all by itself.”

Summary: What Specific Problem Lobelia SolvesLobelia tackles the challenge of monitoring and assessing biodiversity at scale. Traditional biodiversity assessments rely on ground-based data collection, which is often costly, time-consuming, and lacks comprehensive spatial coverage. This limits effective decision-making for conservation, restoration, and sustainable land management.How Lobelia’s Solution WorksLobelia leverages Earth observation (EO) data, AI, and advanced modeling to provide scalable and high-resolution biodiversity insights. By analyzing satellite imagery, climate data, and ecological indicators, Lobelia delivers actionable intelligence on habitat conditions, ecosystem health, and biodiversity trends. This enables policymakers, conservationists, and businesses to make data-driven decisions for environmental sustainability.What Makes Lobelia’s Approach Unique- Scalability & Coverage: Remote sensing allows for global monitoring, overcoming the limitations of localized field studies.- Powerful data management systems and viewers capable to manage huge datasets- AI-Powered Insights: Machine learning enhances the detection of biodiversity patterns and ecosystem dynamics.- Integration with Climate & Environmental Data: A holistic view of biodiversity trends in relation to climate change and human impact.- Actionable Intelligence: Providing stakeholders with clear, science-backed metrics to inform conservation strategies and policy decisions.The Impact Delivered by LobeliaEnhanced Biodiversity Monitoring: Supporting organizations in tracking ecosystem health and detecting early warning signs of degradation.Data-Driven Conservation: Helping governments and NGOs implement more effective biodiversity policies.Sustainable Business Practices: Enabling companies to assess their environmental impact and align with global sustainability goals (e.g., TNFD, COP biodiversity targets).Climate Resilience: Supporting land and resource managers in adapting to climate change by identifying critical areas for conservation and restoration.

Summary: Ozius fuses artificial intelligence, remote sensing technology, and environmental science to help customers structure the chaos of an ever-changing natural environment. With our analytics engine, called Biome, we, created Australia and New Zealand's first national scale 3D vegetation data products that measure vegetation structure every 10cm through the strata, from the ground to the top of canopy with 20 metre pixel size on the ground. The outputs from Biome are used by NGO's, enterprise and government to improve reporting and operational decision making over large remote areas.

Our charitable arm helps communities with land rights, literacy, and living conditions.

Summary: Soilify uses remote sensing to quantify soil carbon stocks for two purposes: enabling farmers to quantify and manage their natural capital and enabling regenerative agriculture financiers to view their impact.

Soilify uses remote sensing to quantify soil carbon stocks for two purposes: enabling farmers to quantify and manage their natural capital and enabling regenerative agriculture financiers to view their impact.
We are developing bioacoustics technology using smart microphones to transparently assess the biodiversity of reforestation project and monitor ecosystems over time

Our mission is to revolutionise nature-based carbon removal placing a strong emphasis on traceability, transparency, and trust through remote sensing technology and AI systems to better measure, monitor, and monetise the carbon impact of nature-based projects. Understanding the challenges in accurately quantifying the carbon impact of nature restoration, Treeconomy has developed a precise, auditable metering system for nature-based carbon dioxide removal.By providing this advanced monitoring technology to Project Developers and connecting them with buyers who seek fairly priced carbon removal credits, we help create and realise value in restoration projects.

Summary: We empower companies to unlock supply chain transparency, mitigate risks, and maximize efficiency — driving sustainable growth through AI-driven decision making.

HowGood has 18 years of research on global food supply chains. The team consolidates and analyzes findings from over 600 accredited data sources and certifications. For over 18 years, HowGood has focused exclusively on agricultural production research for the food industry, setting us apart with our deep expertise and data-driven sustainability solutions. We are the home of best-in-class data that sets the gold standard for sustainability insights in the food and beverage industry. Our SaaS platform, Latis, delivers granular impact data for measuring, improving, and communicating company impact across teams and to the public.

Summary: In Madaster, data are recorded on all materials and products that are incorporated in a real estate or infrastructure object, such as buildings and bridges. Registering every component provides insight, for example, into the degree to which an object can be dismantled, embodied carbon, or the toxicity of the materials and products used. It also enables determining whether materials and products can be reused after disassemblage. Building in such a circular way means that we are drastically reducing the amount of waste and CO2 emissions and are taking better care of our planet.

Summary: In Madaster, data are recorded on all materials and products that are incorporated in a real estate or infrastructure object, such as buildings and bridges. Registering every component provides insight, for example, into the degree to which an object can be dismantled, embodied carbon, or the toxicity of the materials and products used. It also enables determining whether materials and products can be reused after disassemblage. Building in such a circular way means that we are drastically reducing the amount of waste and CO2 emissions and are taking better care of our planet.

Summary:
Circotrade facilitates a full systems change for building owners, development teams, demolition companies, and remanufacturers to enable the reuse of construction materials. 
By inventorying and valuing existing buildings’ materials and their embodied carbon – long before renovation or deconstruction – a critical mass of future materials can be reliably identified and collected. A new tradeable asset class is born, where future costs, carbon savings, timelines and revenues are now known quantities for both the sellers and the buyers.

Summary:
Circotrade facilitates a full systems change for building owners, development teams, demolition companies, and remanufacturers to enable the reuse of construction materials. 
By inventorying and valuing existing buildings’ materials and their embodied carbon – long before renovation or deconstruction – a critical mass of future materials can be reliably identified and collected. A new tradeable asset class is born, where future costs, carbon savings, timelines and revenues are now known quantities for both the sellers and the buyers.

Summary: DNA Gensee is a pionering company specialising in the field of vegetal biotechnology. Recent progress in the field of molecular biology and the advent of next generation sequencing technologies now offer a unique opportunity to precisely identify plants species present in a wide variety of plant-based cosumer goods, from cosmetic products to food supplements or drugs.
